market_outlook.short_term: Risk-on bias continues with Nasdaq at record, but oil decline and Fed hawkishness create volatility. Expect rotation from oil into tech/infrastructure. Diesel tightness supports refining. Watch for US-China talk outcomes this week as key catalyst. Prediction market regulation may create short-term fintech volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains primary equity driver but concentration risk building. Structural diesel shortage into 2027 supports energy margins. Sovereign debt (UK, South Korea) and fiscal sustainability will constrain rate cuts. Climate policy (COP31) creating long-term capital reallocation. Consumer pressure may deepen if inflation persists.
